**Driver — `store/driver.go`** (defined at `store/driver.go:10`).

The interface is documented as "an interface for store driver... all methods that store database driver should implement." Its three implementations live in `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`, `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`, and `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go`.
